dogecoin.text: Originally founded as a nonprofit in 2014 by the founders of the meme cryptocurrency, the Dogecoin Foundation has a number of prominent figures on its advisory board, including longtime Elon Musk collaborator and Neuralink CEO Jared Birchall, Dogecoin co-founder Billy Markus,
#DogecoinBirchall, head of Tesla's (TSLA.O) CEO Musk's family office, will serve as legal and financial advisor to the Dogecoin Foundation.
